title: docserve configuration
description: Configuration file for docserve, a self-hosted MCP documentation server.

data_dir.description: Directory where fetched documentation and the SQLite index are stored. Defaults to "data" relative to the working directory.

listen.description: Address on which the MCP server listens. Defaults to ":8080".

providers.description: List of documentation providers to fetch from.

ProxyConfig.description: Global HTTP/HTTPS proxy settings. Individual providers can opt out with proxy: false.

AuthConfig.description: Authentication configuration. Credentials are read from environment variables, never stored in the config file.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the bearer token.

username_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the username (basic auth).

password_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the password or PAT (basic auth).

RefConfig.description: A Git ref (branch, tag, or SHA) to index from a repository.

ref.description: Branch name, tag, or commit SHA.

name.description: Optional override for the library name derived from this ref.

paths.description: Directories (trailing slash) or file paths to index within the ref.

name.description: Unique name for this repository source.

slug.description: Repository identifier. For GitHub: owner/repo. For Azure DevOps: repository name.

project.description: Azure DevOps project name. Only used with azure-devops provider.

schedule.description: Cron expression overriding the provider-level schedule for this repo.

auth.description: Auth overriding the provider-level auth for this repo.

refs.description: List of refs to index from this repository.

PageConfig.description: A Confluence page to index, optionally including its descendants.

name.description: Optional override for the library name.

depth.description: Subtree depth to index. 0 = root page only, -1 = unlimited (default).

base_url.description: Base URL for the provider instance. Required for azure-devops and confluence.

proxy.description: Whether to route requests through the global proxy. Defaults to true.

schedule.description: Default cron expression for periodic sync of all sources under this provider.

auth.description: Default authentication for all sources under this provider.

repos.description: List of repositories to index. Used by github and azure-devops providers.

pages.description: List of Confluence pages to index. Used by the confluence provider.
